purpose: Pressure-test DynaMol input preparation, engine execution, recovery, progress, diagnostics and trajectory/analysis UI on five benign public structures for 100 ps each. These are software tests: GPCR/channel runs intentionally use explicit water without a membrane, as explicitly approved, and no physiological dynamics, stability, gating, catalysis, pose accuracy or convergence inference is permitted.
review_identity: Language-model evidence synthesis and automated PatAgent checklist; not professional certification or Pat Walters endorsement.

reproducibility.budget: 4 CPU threads per job; at most 2 concurrent native jobs on the 10-CPU laptop. Five 100 ps trajectories, plus 10 ps relaxation per case, 2 fs step, reporting every500steps (1ps), temperature300K; minimization max1000iterations. At most2hours and5GB percase before recording a runtime/resource issue. Each ligand preparation native subprocess remains bounded300seconds. NoGPU/cloud/membrane construction; production sourceapp/user-library untouched by fixtures. Use isolated data/integration-checks/five-system-* and docs/audit/five-system-pressure-test; hash exact selected/prepared/solvated inputs and record complete settings before each production launch.

data.policy: Official deposited coordinate/sequence/assembly records are preserved. Derivatives retain exact observed heavy coordinates and document chain, assembly, solvent/additive removal and terminal omissions. GROMACS uses complete unprepared standard protein inputs; no missing internal residues or ligand deletion to force compatibility. OpenMM retains primary ligands and validated ions. Modeled protein/ligand atoms require explicit recorded choice and uncertainty. GPCR uses the complete observed transmembrane construct rather than an unlabeled soluble fragment. Channel requires tetramer assembly and explicit nonoverlapping ion-occupancy interpretation; symmetry-axis ions cannot be multiplied silently.

validation.scope: Initial planned benchmark preflight; per-case launch remains subject to actual dry validation, native force-field preparation and preserved input hashes. Soluble GROMACS cases have already passed actual validate_simulation with no missing heavy atoms or internal gaps.

openmm_case_gates.3PTB: Terminal-imine stereo perception fix now independently reviewed and regressed; records unverified CCD descriptor and preserves all observable/explicit stereo mismatch gates. Actual inspection passes and selects BEN+1 atpH7. Retain BEN/Ca and preserve insertion-code source provenance; standard native preparation/force-field and exact input-hash validation still required before production.
openmm_case_gates.4BVN: Verify the six missing internal positions (auth241–243,272–274; label211–216) form a supported gap and can be modeled under existing cap; retain P32/Na; explicitly omit MHA/OLC additives; no membrane and no receptor-function claim.
openmm_case_gates.1K4C: Exact assembly/occupancy proposal now recorded in review-channel-ions.json: four channel subunits from entity3 operators1–4, K3002/3004/3005 once each, explicit omitted partners/sites; original/source coordinates and derived topology require native validation beforeproduction.

output_checks: Actual100ps production endtime and monotonic saved time/frame counts
Finite native potential/kinetic energies and temperature; no missing/duplicate samples after recovery
Source-to-prepared atom identities, assembly count, ligand/ion inventory and modeled/excluded provenance
Readable trajectory and live/offline measurements agree on saved physical frames
RMSD/RMSF and geometry plots are software outputs only; 100ps provides no equilibrium/convergence evidence
Keep failures in benchmark log; report selection/setup adaptations rather than success-only results

comparison.notes: No engine ranking or physical equivalence claim; OpenMM and GROMACS presets use different force fields. No holdout scientific dataset or uncertainty estimate is asserted.
